test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A ray of light bends towards the normal while travelling from medium A to medium B. Which of the following statements is/ are correct:

(A) Medium A is optically denser than medium B.

(B) Speed of light is more in medium A than medium B.

(C) Refractive index of medium B is more than refractive index of medium A.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both B and C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When a **wave travels from one medium to another, it bends**, which is known as **refraction**.
 
• If the light is travelling from a** rarer medium to a denser medium**, the light will get** refracted towards the normal** while if the light is travelling from a **denser medium to a rarer medium**, the light will get **refracted away from the normal**.
 
• When a ray of light bends towards the normal while travelling from a rarer to a denser medium, the **speed of light is more in a rarer medium** than a denser medium and the **refractive index of a denser medium is more** than the refractive index of a rarer medium.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dispersion** is the **process by which white light separates into the colours that make up its spectrum (in order VIBGYOR) when it passes through a glass prism**.
 
• **When light travels through one medium, **such as air or a glass of water,** it is partially absorbed by the medium's particles before radiating in a certain direction afterwards**. This is called the **scattering of light**. The **light's wavelength and the size of the scattered particles** both affect the scattered light **intensity**.
 
• When **light beams move from a denser medium to one that is considerably less dense, total internal reflection** occur.
 
• Total internal reflections occur when the** angle of incidence is greater than the critical angle**.
